richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhusawal

c: Bhusawal is one of the big railway junctions of central India, in Jalgaon district of north Maharashtra, and many families here live in railway and other government colonies. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bhusawal to those colonies and to schools, colleges, municipal gardens and private housing. Our factory in Vasai is about 350 km away, within the same state, so delivery is a straightforward road trip.

Summer in the Tapi valley is among the harshest in the state, with afternoons that keep people indoors from March to June. An open gym here is used mainly at dawn and after dark, so plan lighting along with the machines. The ground in many colony parks is black cotton soil, which swells when wet and cracks when dry. For that reason we usually grout each post into a concrete footing that goes below the cracking layer.

items.q: Can a railway or government colony in Bhusawal order outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. Send us the park size, photos and the number of residents likely to use it. We will propose machines with a layout drawing and a quote for your approval.

items.q: Does black cotton soil affect installation?
items.a: It can, because the soil moves between wet and dry seasons. We usually grout each post into a deeper concrete footing so the machine stays level through the year.
We roto-mould parts in more than 15 shades. In Bhusawal's heat, lighter colours stay cooler to touch, so many buyers pick them for seats and handles.
